title: Two vulnerabilities in Check Point VPN allow RCE without password. Link to article: https://www.redhotcyber.com/post/due-vulnerabilita-in-check-point-vpn-consentono-rce-senza-password/
content_md:
Two vulnerabilities in Check Point VPN allow RCE without password. Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary code on affected security gateways.

via Mastodon https://www.redhotcyber.com/post/due-vulnerabilita-in-check-point-vpn-consentono-rce-senza-password/
